missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Лицо' is the neuter nominative subject of the possession frame 'у неё'. 'Доброе' is the agreeing neuter adjective, and 'очень' intensifies the description.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Лицо' is the accusative direct object of 'мою'. Neuter inanimate nouns keep the nominative form in the accusative, and 'каждое утро' marks the routine.

missions.phrase: У него не было лица от страха.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive after negation. 'Лица' is the genitive form required by 'не было', an idiom meaning he turned pale. 'От страха' gives the cause in the genitive.
Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'В лицо' uses the accusative 'лицо' after 'в' to show motion onto the face. 'Прямо' emphasises the direct angle of the light.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'На лице' uses the prepositional form 'лице' after 'на' to place the smile. 'Улыбка' is the nominative subject of 'была'.
Strategic focus: Dative after 'по'. 'По лицу' uses the dative 'лицу' to show the wind striking across the face. 'Холодный ветер' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Accusative object with instrumental. 'Лицо' is the accusative direct object of 'закрыл'. 'Руками' is the instrumental plural showing the means by which he covered it.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Лицо' is the accusative direct object of 'помню', identical to the nominative for neuter nouns. 'Это' agrees in the neuter, and 'хорошо' adds clarity of memory.

missions.phrase: В толпе было много знакомых лиц.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive plural after quantity. 'Лиц' is the genitive plural required by 'много'. 'Знакомых' agrees in the genitive plural, and 'в толпе' sets the prepositional location.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of characteristic. 'Лицом' is the instrumental after 'с', describing the person by a trait. 'Приятным' agrees in the neuter instrumental.
